With Michael focused on the family's new pizzeria, it's the couple's 16-year-old daughter Felicia who joins forces with Mom to find and renovate the perfect family home. First, Drew leads them on an ambitious house hunt and then gives critical advice when a bidding war erupts over a deal that's too good to be true. Later, Jonathan is on track to deliver everything on their wish list. That is, until his clients slash the budget just weeks before the big reveal.

episodes.title: Charming Fixer-Upper with Unexpected Issues
episodes.summary: A chemical engineer with a jet-set lifestyle, Karima has been working and living all over the world. But after six years as a nomad, it's time to reconnect with family and friends so now she's looking for a deluxe urban home of her own. With his client asking a lot from her modest budget, it's up to Drew to find a well-priced diamond in the rough. Later, the renovations on a ramshackle Victorian are plagued by a series of break-ins that shake Karima's confidence. Meanwhile, it's up to Jonathan to rejig the design as a pileup of costly surprises threatens to derail the project altogether.

episodes.title: Dream City, Dream Job, Dream Home
episodes.summary: After years of living out of a suitcase, it's time for globetrotting Aussies Levi and Alysha to put down roots. And since they've already landed dream jobs in their dream city, the only thing left on their list is a dream home. With the couple more focused on lifestyle than size, Drew leads the hunt for a dog friendly home in a trendy urban neighborhood where compromise is key. Later, Jonathan comes up with an optical illusion to compensate for saggy walls in the kitchen, and the vintage charm of a century home reveals its dark side with a shocking surprise that threatens to bust the budget wide open.

episodes.title: Bachelor Pad Condo to Family-Friendly Home
episodes.summary: Tired of squeezing into his bachelor pad condo and ready to move to the suburbs, Erin and Adam are searching for the perfect family-friendly home. But while they've got a healthy budget and a very clear wish list, these indecisive newlyweds can't seem to make up their minds. The couple's house hunt proves to be an uphill battle from the start as Adam's lowball approach leads to a series of rejections. That is, until a patient straight-talking Drew intervenes. At the negotiating table, Erin makes a snap decision that could come back to haunt them. During the demo, Adam's 91-year-old grandpa pitches in. Later, Jonathan breezes through a disaster-free renovation though he finds himself juggling last-minute changes and serious indecision.

episodes.title: Ready for Home Sweet Home
episodes.summary: Since relocating for his dream job, Jaeme, Bliss and their two little ones have been crashing with friends in the city. They need to find their own home fast, but the odds are stacked against them. Their wish list is too long, and for a homesick Bliss, the family's dream home is the one they left behind. Drew's advice with a tricky estate sale proves critical, and it's up to Jonathan to transform a dusty home into a midcentury modern gem. Unfortunately, Bliss' exacting standards have Jonathan seriously concerned about the big reveal.

episodes.title: Spending, Add-Ons and a Property That Fits the Bill
episodes.summary: Sarah and Kevin spent years renovating their tiny home, but with a baby boy and changing priorities, they're desperate for a sprawling suburban home with all the bells and whistles. Drew and Jonathan vow to find them a stylish midcentury-inspired property that fits the bill, but the only way the couple will agree to renovate is if Drew grabs a tool belt and pitches in. Multiple offers threaten to complicate their exhausting house hunt, and a tricky demolition challenge finds Drew running the streets in his boxers. Meanwhile, Jonathan struggles to keep up with ongoing design changes as Sarah's spending threatens to derail the budget.

episodes.title: Perfect Pair Ready for a Perfect Pad
episodes.summary: Ambitious newlyweds Michelle and Jon are determined to move out of his parents' basement and into a forever home of their own. But even with an ample budget, their real estate dreams are out of step with the market. That is, until Jonathan and Drew step in with a wakeup call and a custom solution guaranteed to satisfy these two perfectionists. Drew soon learns the downside to showing Michelle a house with everything she wants, because now she wants everything. Later, Jonathan leads the search for a time capsule that's rumored to be hidden in the couple's new home, and then comes up with creative way to keep them from draining the budget.

episodes.title: Navigating Rough Waters for a Picture Perfect Property
episodes.summary: Tyler and Lindsay love their waterfront lifestyle, but their tiny condo is giving them the squeeze. They desperately need a family home where they can put down roots, but finding a property in their exclusive neighborhood will mean compromising on their wish list. Jonathan and Drew step in with a solution, and Drew leads the search for a fixer-upper with lots of charm. Determined to secure 'the one,' Lindsay reaches out to make a personal connection with the seller. Meanwhile, it's all hands on deck for an ambitious reno, especially when costly surprises in the kitchen and basement have Jonathan scrambling for ways to save money.

episodes.title: Searching for Glitz and Glam
episodes.summary: Busy parents Dorothy and John have been crashing in his parents' basement, and with baby number two on the way, they're desperate to find a home of their own. Drew leads the couple to a property with great bones and makes the best of a rare opportunity. Meanwhile, Jonathan works his magic while tackling the couple's conflicting tastes. As the walls come down, the problems pile up, and even though their budget is under siege, the couple earns Jonathan's respect as two of the most optimistic people he's ever met.

episodes.title: Game-time Decision
episodes.summary: Monique and coach Carl have been house hunting for five long years, but he's fixated on a move-in ready mansion and they're running out of time. Taking his turn as coach, Drew challenges the couple to make a decision after just one day of showings, and then it's up to Jonathan to tackle the ambitious renovation. Demolition day turns into a competition as the brothers lead rival teams to dusty glory, but there's nothing funny about a flooded basement and a massive pile-up of costly fixes. Jonathan tries to get the budget back on track, but Carl makes it clear that there are some must-haves he won't sacrifice.

episodes.title: Collaboration and Teamwork
episodes.summary: Kevin and Shirley are stuck in rental limbo after selling their house much faster than they had anticipated. The Property Brothers are there to help them find a home that will cut down their commute time so they can spend more time with their daughters and customize it to perfectly fit their needs. They think they've found the place, but with renovations eating up the budget, will these busy parents end up with the dream home they're wanting for their family?

episodes.title: Character and Closed Concept
episodes.summary: Barbra and Greg are ready to set down some family roots in a home of their own after living in five rentals over four years. Jonathan and Drew help this busy family find a live-work property in a neighborhood they've been eyeing and customize it to meet the family's needs, but renovations unearth a triple threat of deadly issues in the kitchen. Despite the issues, the Property Brothers are determined to take care of this family and come through with a special surprise.

episodes.title: Modern Must-Have
episodes.summary: Debra and Dan are squeezed into a tiny urban condo with their three small children and have dreams of staying in the heart of the city. The Property Brothers are leading the charge to help this family find a fixer-upper to transform. Once Drew finds them an older home, Jonathan sets out to turn it into a sleek, modern space with vaulted ceilings and modern finishes. Will Jonathan and Drew be able to manage this design-savvy family's rising expectations?

episodes.title: Delivering a Dream Home Just in Time
episodes.summary: With three kids and another's due date fast approaching, Dave and Lizzy are desperate to get out of their rental and into the home of their dreams. Jonathan and Drew step in with a real estate intervention that starts with a targeted house hunt and the couple compromising on style. During demolition, Jonathan uncovers a laundry list of small issues but is determined to give the kids everything on their wish lists, while hardworking Lizzy steps in with an innovative solution for a pricey fix and Dave works on a surprise for her. Will they have their dream home before Lizzy's due date?

episodes.title: Condo to Countryside
episodes.summary: Tennis pros Jessica and Nathan have been living the cramped condo lifestyle for way too long and they're desperate to find a sprawling home in the country where they can put down roots and entertain family in style. Drew jumpstarts their new life by finding a perfect suburban home with everything on their wish list, but as the walls come down, Jonathan and his shell-shocked clients are faced with massive repairs from the foundation to the roof. Somehow Jessica and Nathan manage to take it all in stride as Jonathan vows to work his contractor magic.

episodes.title: Unexpected Dream Home
episodes.summary: Juggling after-school activities and busy careers, Mark and Eugenie haven't had much time for house hunting. And while the couple has a luxurious list of must-haves, Drew and Jonathan warn they'll need to compromise if they want to box up their rental situation for good. Encouraging the couple to keep an open mind, Drew comes up with a creative range of options including a sprawling showstopper that might just deliver everything on their wish list. During demolition, the added repairs add up faster than anyone expected. Jonathan comes up with a germophobe-friendly solution for the massive fireplace. But even with the budget stretched to the max, the couple rejects nearly every one of his money-saving suggestions.

episodes.title: Century Home Showstopper
episodes.summary: Sandi and Phil have lived in their park-filled waterfront neighborhood for years. But with the arrival of their baby boy, they've suddenly outgrown their one-room, loft-style apartment and are searching for an allergy-free forever home where they can put down roots. The Property Brothers step in with a plan to maximize the couple's nest egg, but winning Sandi's trust is job number one. Drew leads them to a house with great bones and successfully leverages the results of a home inspection at the negotiating table. Meanwhile, Jonathan is determined to transform a sagging century home into a showpiece, but from the basement to the roof, he uncovers every imaginable setback along the way.

episodes.title: Fixer-upper for Dog Lovers
episodes.summary: Leslie and Tim have been living with her parents since they sold their condo, and while they agree it's time to move, she prefers the city while he wants to live in the suburbs. Jonathan and Drew step in to find a dog-friendly fixer-upper with potential to be a forever home, but their first job is getting Leslie and Tim to agree on location. The couple follows Drew's advice and scores a hot property in a competitive market, but Jonathan faces a basement flood while coming up with a contemporary design that will earn Mom's seal of approval.

episodes.title: Rustic-Meets-Modern Design
episodes.summary: Kyle and Jackie have a healthy budget for a home of their own, but they've set their sights on one of the city's priciest neighborhoods. Their demanding jobs and lifestyle leave no time for renovations, so the Property Brothers step in with a real estate intervention. Drew teaches them how to succeed in a competitive market, and later, Jonathan pulls off a minor miracle to deliver an out-of-stock flooring option while his clients overthink his rustic-modern design.

episodes.title: Modern Masterpiece for Two
episodes.summary: Engaged and homeless, Andrew and Phil are couch-surfing their way around the city while dreaming of a sprawling downtown home of their own. Phil is hands-on, and Andrew has an eye for design, and together with the Property Brothers, they're determined to transform a dog-friendly fixer-upper with dream home potential. Drew presents a lowball offer that leads to a surprising outcome, and Jonathan tackles a total gut job. The result is a blank slate for Andrew's modernist vision, but Phil has three veto votes to ensure the result is fit for two.

episodes.title: Hunting for the One
episodes.summary: A couple with a baby on the way searches for the perfect suburban home close to their family. The Property Brothers step in with a custom solution but since the couple's target area is only a few blocks wide, the hunt for a fixer-upper proves particularly tricky. Once they find "the one," it's up to Jonathan to transform the dated canvas into a midcentury modern masterpiece.

episodes.title: Building a Solid Foundation
episodes.summary: The Property Brothers attempt to combine a couple's different wish lists in order to help them put down roots in Nashville, but the house hunt hits a snag with a substantial mark-up of a century-old contender. With the budget stretched to the max, Jonathan must walk a tightrope to avoid any unanticipated costs.

episodes.title: Big City Move
episodes.summary: A busy woman packs up her frantic life and moves to Nashville to begin living the life of her dreams. Drew helps her find a cozy, eclectic pad in an up-and-coming neighborhood that's big enough for a new dog and visitors from back home. Jonathan works with her imaginative boho-chic style, but struggles to keep the renovation on track after unexpected repairs start piling up.

episodes.title: Lakeside Dreaming
episodes.summary: After living in a rental property for three years, a family realizes they've outgrown their home and is ready to find a permanent place in their exclusive lakefront community. Drew and Jonathan take charge trying to find a home in the immediate neighborhood and quickly run into unforeseen obstacles. While the family's taste for equestrian chic proves expensive, the project is completed after a surprise contribution comes in from an unexpected source.

episodes.title: Miles Apart
episodes.summary: A couple tries to move closer to family and friends to cut back on their morning commute. While they agree a move is necessary, they're miles apart when it comes to design. The Property Brothers step in to find them the perfect suburban home but immediately run into potentially serious issues. Once they settle on a home and the walls come down, Jonathan finds himself fighting to keep the budget under control. After he gets the project back on track, a snag at city hall comes up that may bring all their hard work to a screeching halt.

episodes.title: Craving More Space for the Family
episodes.summary: Jonathan and Drew accelerate the house hunt for a close-knit but cramped family of four. Jonathan is determined to deliver a family-friendly space for entertaining, but his budget goes out the window after the design-challenged homeowner goes rogue.

episodes.title: Changing Direction
episodes.summary: Frustrated by their urban house hunt, a couple agrees to a radically different approach as Jonathan and Drew take them on a tour of an amazing rural community. They are soon sold on the long list of perks, and it's up to Jonathan to come up with an open-concept design that dovetails with his clients' lifestyle.

episodes.title: Honeymooning and House Hunting
episodes.summary: Newlyweds with two dogs and a mile-long wish list are determined to move out of their cramped condo into the perfect modern property, and the Property Brothers promise to make it happen with a fixer-upper. After Drew successfully coaches the couple through a potential bidding war, Jonathan wrestles with asbestos, ancient wiring and structural issues to keep the ambitious project on time and on budget.

episodes.title: Straightening Out a Sagging Century Home
episodes.summary: The Property Brothers help family of five search for a forever home in their high-demand school district. Drew somehow manages to come up with a short list, and then it's up to Jonathan to straighten a seriously sagging century home. The problems start piling up as soon as the walls come down, and then the renovation is thrown completely off track by a hole that threatens to sink the entire project.

episodes.title: A Different Dream
episodes.summary: A single mom adjusts to her new life by selling her sprawling Nashville dream home and searching for a more manageable property. Drew and Jonathan promise a worry-free transition and begin their search for a low-maintenance urban property with plenty of country flair. Jonathan is able to transform a tired old ranch home into a fabulous showpiece and Drew commemorates the occasion by organizing an official welcome-to-the-neighborhood block party.

episodes.title: Overcoming Analysis Paralysis
episodes.summary: A super-planner that's been crashing at her best friend's place knows it's time to find a Nashville pad of her own. After her best friend comes up with an off-the-market solution, Jonathan tackles an ambitious renovation, but the list of add-ons keeps piling up.

episodes.title: Shaky Start
episodes.summary: Empty nesters that sold their home the first day it was on the market want to find a deluxe retreat where they can hang with their grandsons in style. Drew lines up family-friendly properties, and Jonathan has big plans to inject French country charm into a dated fixer-upper.

episodes.title: Making Their House a Home
episodes.summary: A military couple with twin toddlers has outgrown their cramped Nashville condo and want to find a farmhouse-style home where they have room to grow. After a contender is sold out from under them, a surprise solution gets them back on track. However, while Jonathan is determined to deliver a showstopper, the renovations are slammed with unexpected challenges.

episodes.title: Costly Charm for a Vintage Dreamer
episodes.summary: An up-and-coming musician is ready to settle down in Nashville. It's up to Drew to find a home with great bones and loads of vintage charm, while it's Jonathan's job to transform a vintage abode into a hip home without breaking the bank.

episodes.title: Searching for the Heart of the Home
episodes.summary: A homesick couple from Wisconsin is ready to put down roots in Nashville after relocating for a dream job. Drew leads the hunt for midcentury modern gem, while Jonathan starts a massive renovation that includes a second master suite for an aging dad.

episodes.title: Mad About Plaid
episodes.summary: A family of four has been living under Grandma's roof to support her through a tough time, but now they're ready for a house of their own. After finding a fixer-upper with great bones, exclusive tastes and a slew of big-ticket surprises eat into the budget.

episodes.title: Family Above All Else
episodes.summary: After moving back to his hometown of Nashville to be closer to family, a couple's home search has taken longer than expected. They're desperate to get out of his childhood bedroom and into a kid-friendly dream home of their own. They finally choose a home with Drew, and after demolition, Jonathan steps in to make some critical design choices when the homeowners are indecisive.

episodes.title: Striking the Right Chord
episodes.summary: A couple with a baby is living in her dad's cramped condo while looking for a home near Nashville's Music Row. After getting outbid in the city's hot market, Drew finds them two great contenders. However, a bulging basement wall threatens to bring down the budget and the house.

episodes.title: Expecting the Unexpected
episodes.summary: After traveling the world and tying the knot, newlyweds are on the hunt for a sprawling urban home where they can raise a family. Because their condo sold faster than expected, Drew signs on for an express house hunt. Then, Jonathan must find a style compromise that suits the couple's opposing aesthetics.

episodes.title: Floored by the Renovation
episodes.summary: An exasperated couple is ready to give up on their home search after viewing more than 200 properties and losing out on 14 bids. To make matters worse, their condo sold more quickly than expected, so they're crashing at her parents' house. Drew and Jonathan are determined to turn things around, but the hunt for a pedestrian-friendly property ends with a calculated risk that could have major consequences down the line.

episodes.title: Country Chic for a New Generation
episodes.summary: After more than 30 years in their rented farmhouse, a couple is on the hunt for a rural retirement home of their own with plenty of space to entertain family and friends. However, finding a sprawling country property that fits their wish list proves tricky for Drew and Jonathan, until their search leads back to a family homestead from the past.

episodes.title: Uplift and Electrify
episodes.summary: A family of four hunts for a sprawling dream home to call their own. Jonathan and Drew lead the search for the deluxe suburban pad, but it's a tall order even with the family's big budget.

episodes.title: Tight Transformation
episodes.summary: A couple with twin toddlers is eager to relocate, but their whirlwind of a house hunt has left them exhausted and discouraged. Drew helps the couple close on a great home in their preferred school district, but the seller's counter offer raises eyebrows and the budget. It's up to Jonathan to find savings wherever he can to deliver a stunning transformation on a tighter budget.

episodes.title: Mistress of Her Domain
episodes.summary: A buyer looking for a fresh start hunts for a modern turnkey property to be her new home base. The search is on for a two-story home in the same community, but Jonathan and Drew convince her to make a move she never saw coming.

episodes.title: Wishful Building
episodes.summary: After four moves in nine years, a family is ready to trade in their townhouse for a customized forever home, causing the brothers to juggle their constantly growing wish list. Drew leverages a stale listing to get the best possible deal, and Jonathan works alongside a family member to infuse hotel-chic interiors with heart and soul.

episodes.title: The High Cost of Cool
episodes.summary: Downtown dwellers give up their tiny urban condo to find a detached home with more space and the same modern aesthetic, but hope dwindles after missing out on four offers. Drew finds a tired midcentury frame for Jonathan to transform, but when the walls come down, they discover a toxic disaster that stretches to every corner of the house.

episodes.title: Structural Opportunity
episodes.summary: A couple with a toddler and newborn are ready to move out of his old bachelor pad condo and into a dream home that's close to family. During the house hunt, Drew is impressed by the couple's nose for real estate as they take a risk on a house that's no longer on the market. Later, it's up to Jonathan to transform a century-old property into a modern gem, all while finding a style compromise that will suit both of their opposing tastes.

episodes.title: Reno Interrupted
episodes.summary: After a family crisis moved them back in with mom and dad, a couple is ready and eager to move on in a new home of their own. But a tricky house hunt leads back to square one as the Property Brothers try to convince them to see dream-home potential in an unfinished DIY disaster. Later, it's up to Jonathan to act as mediator and deliver a dazzling renovation that makes them forget their troubled past.

episodes.title: Designing Memories
episodes.summary: After bouncing around from one rental disaster to the next, a couple is ready to find a first home that's as quirky as they are, and the Property Brothers are determined to make it happen. During the house hunt, Drew manages to find a low-priced gem in a red-hot neighborhood, but that's when their luck runs out. With a slew of nasty surprises, Jonathan struggles to stay on top of the schedule and budget while balancing their very eccentric style.

episodes.title: Wide Open Dreams
episodes.summary: After frequent moves and a too-small rental apartment, Jennifer and David need to find a Nashville property where they can settle down for good with their two boys. Drew handles a tricky negotiation to land a house with great bones, but when the walls come down, the unexpected costs start piling up. Jonathan transforms a hidden opportunity into a dramatic vaulted ceiling and calls on a friend to help with a surprise that ensures future accessibility for the couple's youngest son.

episodes.title: Color Clash
episodes.summary: After years of moving around the country, Lesli and Dave are ready to call Nashville home. Drew leads the hunt for a fixer-upper with potential to be a forever home, but the couple must decide whether to go for their lakefront dream or stay closer to the city. Later, Jonathan must keep Lesli calm as the budget takes a series of hits, and then he hustles to finish in time for Dave's neighborhood housewarming party.

episodes.title: Living in Harmony
episodes.summary: After a year in cramped quarters, a couple is ready to move out of a tiny backyard shed and into a cozy cottage of their own. Jonathan and Drew help them search Nashville's red-hot real estate market for a unique live-work space that suits their clashing home-office requirements. Drew masters a nail-biting negotiation, but a higher-than-expected purchase price leaves Jonathan with a significantly reduced renovation budget.

episodes.title: Sister, Sister
episodes.summary: After years of being on the road, Sonja has finally landed a job closer to family in Nashville, and her sister Michelle helps make her house hunt a priority. Drew leads her to a property with great bones, but an unexpected twist leaves Sonja with a tricky decision. Later, with Sonja as his design partner, Jonathan is determined to create a deluxe family hideaway.

episodes.title: Family Fun House
episodes.summary: Hoping to find a bigger property for their growing family, Susy and Scott put their perfect but undersized home on the market. An unexpected quick sale leaves the family of five squeezed into a hotel room while they search for the perfect, sprawling house. Drew and Jonathan are determined to set them up with a house fit for entertaining, and Drew leads the couple to a Nashville property with loads of potential. Jonathan turns mish-mash medieval interiors into a contemporary showpiece, and when the budget takes a beating, everyone pitches in to save money and de-stress Dad.

episodes.title: Making Momma Happy
episodes.summary: A suburban family is eager to cut down their commute and move into a home in central Nashville. Drew learns that when momma's happy, everyone's happy, and is surprised when the search leads to familiar grounds. Later, it's up to Jonathan to turn a forgotten property into a modern dream home, but as soon as the walls come down, the disasters start piling up.

episodes.title: Renovation Therapy
episodes.summary: A couple with two kids is desperate to move out of his bachelor pad and into a spacious family home. After a lowball offer shuts them out of a negotiation on a stately property, their house hunt takes a surprising turn. Later, Jonathan faces costly challenges that hammer the budget and leave everyone scrambling for creative solutions.

episodes.title: Cool Under Pressure
episodes.summary: A newlywed couple is prepared to tackle their first renovation together, and Drew leads the search for a private, family-friendly property. While Jonathan tries to find a design compromise between Bohemian style and Vegas hotel chic, the reno is riddled with wonky issues from the floor to the ceiling.

episodes.title: Home with a View
episodes.summary: A couple looks for a forever home to share in a popular lakefront community outside of Nashville, and the choice comes down to two very different contenders. Jonathan comes up with a cost-saving measure to save the vaulted ceiling, but a costly electrical issue emerges after the entire contingency fund is spent on upgrades.

episodes.title: A Little Bit of Home
episodes.summary: A Nashville couple and their teenage kids are moving for the tenth time in 15 years. Drew is on board to find a sprawling suburban property that will become the family's forever home. During the renovation, Jonathan struggles with the budget as costly problems with the pool and chimney add up.

episodes.title: Mountain Chic
episodes.summary: After their house sold quicker than expected, a family is squatting at grandma's place until they can find the perfect mountain-chic family pad. Though they're determined to stay in the same neighborhood, Drew warns they'll have to widen their search if they want to get everything on their wish list. Later, asbestos cleanup hits the budget hard, forcing Jonathan to race to finish the reno five days earlier than projected.

episodes.title: Cheer-tastic Design
episodes.summary: A single mom and her three cheerleading kids search for a new home where they can make a fresh start. Drew leads the search for a spacious gymnastics-friendly home with grandma's support. Later, Jonathan is forced to get creative while completing the cottage retreat as the budget takes a hit and a surprise reaction forces him to second-guess his approach.

episodes.title: The Homesick Cure
episodes.summary: The Property Brothers promise to make a fixer-upper feel like home for a couple who recently moved to a new city. Drew takes charge of the house hunt and a decisive move proves critical at the negotiating table. Later, it's up to Jonathan to transform a single-story property into a family-friendly oasis, but unexpected problems soon threaten the bottom line.

episodes.title: Nutty and Proud
episodes.summary: The Property Brothers convince a family to move out of their friend's basement and into a downtown fixer-upper. First, Drew must leverage a home inspection to prevent them from overpaying, then Jonathan must find a compromise for their very different styles. But after a major excavation in the bedroom, a delivery delay threatens to keep the family out in the cold.

episodes.title: From Fault to Vault
episodes.summary: After selling their home sooner than expected, a couple with two young kids is desperate to get out of their temporary rental and into a family-friendly home of their own. Drew leads the couple to an unlikely house that may be exactly what their family needs after a little work. Meanwhile, Jonathan is determined to make this anxiety-causing renovation as simple as possible while working with a vaulted ceiling and an ambitious garage addition.

episodes.title: Party on the Hill
episodes.summary: After navigating a long-distance relationship, a couple finally decides to put down roots and build a home together in Brazil. Now, the two outdoorsy engineers are looking for the perfect mountain-view home where they can entertain friends and family. The couple is enthusiastic about a major reno so Drew steps in to find an urban property that ticks all their boxes. Later, it's up to Jonathan to level a very wonky home while nailing down the clients' modern-yet-rustic style.

episodes.title: Gambles and Jackpots
episodes.summary: Newlyweds sacrifice their honeymoon to find a dream home, but after visiting over 150 properties, they need an intervention. Drew leads the home search, and while she's quick to choose the first property they see, he's not quite so eager. Later, Jonathan pulls off a jaw-dropping renovation to make the clients feel like they're in paradise, even when they're at home.

episodes.title: Glitz and Glamour
episodes.summary: A Minneapolis couple relocates to Las Vegas in search of a midcentury modern gem. Drew finds a classic 1960s property for the two men, one of whom has a drag queen alter ego named Margo. A famous drag queen offers design tips for Margo's "drag room." Jonathan works his magic and brings the bling, despite major cost overruns and a break-in.

episodes.title: Hometown Vegas
episodes.summary: A young family in Las Vegas wants kid-friendly home in an established neighborhood away from the Strip. Drew finds a retro option, but the couple's low offer is met with silence from the seller. Later, Jonathan struggles with the ambitious renovation on a small budget but manages to deliver a knockout property complete with backyard oasis.

episodes.title: New Start, New Home, New Memories
episodes.summary: Las Vegas newlyweds do tons of charity work to give back to the city they love, and now the Property Brothers are stepping in to help this generous family find and update their first home together with no wiggle room in the budget.

episodes.title: A Home to Hug
episodes.summary: A semiretired military man is looking for his dream home. After looking at more than 100 homes, Drew finds the one. Then a lowball offer nearly backfires at the negotiating table, and Jonathan discovers a major weakness in the home's foundation.

episodes.title: Strength in Numbers
episodes.summary: A couple sold their Las Vegas home before they could find a new one. With seven kids and another on the way, they're desperate to get out of grandma's place. Drew leads the couple to a property with great bones, and Jonathan discovers no home is move-in ready for a family of 10.

episodes.title: Owning an Oasis
episodes.summary: A couple of newlyweds in Las Vegas is eager to buy a dog-friendly property and never pay rent again. Drew is able to quickly narrow down their search. However, when a kitchen demolition uncovers a nasty surprise, Jonathan is determined to stretch the budget and rescue the design plan.

episodes.title: Tear Downs and I Dos
episodes.summary: With their wedding just months away, this couple hopes to find and renovate their forever home -- with room for their growing brood of rescue dogs. A narrow search area puts Drew in the hot seat, and a low-ball offer eventually leads to a deal no one saw coming. Later, it's up to Jonathan to keep the reno on track so the couple can move in before tying the knot.

episodes.title: Fit to Reno
episodes.summary: After moving from city to city to grow their businesses, a couple is settling down in Las Vegas, NV. Drew is determined to put an end to their moving streak, but the husband's low-ball offer threatens to derail a great deal. Later, Jonathan must figure out the couple's design style to transform a dated property into a fully-loaded, forever home.

episodes.title: Blending Vibes
episodes.summary: A couple juggling house hunting and child rearing is desperate to get out of their rental close to the noisy strip in Las Vegas, NV. Drew must save the day when the couple walks away from the negotiating table. Later, Jonathan gets creative to blend their farmhouse and midcentury modern vibe.

episodes.title: Vegas for Good
episodes.summary: After losing everything in a devastating house fire, soon-to-be empty nesters are seeking a perfect home in her hometown of Las Vegas, NV. Drew shepherds the couple through a tough negotiation that leads back to square one. Later, Jonathan pulls out all the stops to deliver a picture-perfect renovation.

episodes.title: Island Getaway
episodes.summary: A Miami couple moved to Vegas "temporarily" for work. Ten years, two kids and a bunch of rentals later, they have to admit it's permanent. Drew finds them a home that ticks all the boxes, while Jonathan juggles termite damage and last-minute changes.
